101.name: Central Sea Lone Isle
101.desc: A mid-sized island adrift on the vast sea, surrounded on all sides by deep blue water.

102.name: Northern Sea Sand Isle
102.desc: A sandy isle in the northern shallows, where reef flats and gobi-colored dunes interlace and the waves keep redrawing the shore.

105.name: Boundless Sea Realm
105.desc: Here the sea itself is the land; shipping lanes and currents are the only features of its surface.

106.name: Tidal Channel
106.desc: A channel formed where deep water meets shallow, a natural path from island to island.

118.name: Outer Penglai Isle
118.desc: A lone island far from the main archipelago, like a shard of jade scattered on the sea.

103.name: Western Rain Isle
103.desc: A large, hot and humid island in the western waters, where rainforest grows right up to the shore and ancient vines and sea mist wrap the land deep.

104.name: Northern Ice Isle
104.desc: An ice island ringed by cold northern currents, where sea winds carry flurries across icy shores and tundra.

107.name: Eastern Sea Rock Isle
107.desc: A rocky island rising from the eastern sea, its cliffs, reef shores, and ridges pressed tightly together.

108.name: Cold Tide Snow Isle
108.desc: A snow-peaked island piled up by the cold tides of the northern sea; its ice cliffs mirror the sea light and from afar it looks like a floating white ridge.

109.name: Central Sea Oasis
109.desc: A gentle, green island at the heart of the archipelago, one of the few open places to settle among the isles.

110.name: Green Wood Inner Bay
110.desc: A wooded island embraced by a bay, where forest shade and humid mountain winds overlap, ideal for gathering Wood-element spiritual qi.

111.name: Red Reef Fire Isle
111.desc: A volcanic island in the western chain, where red rock reefs reach into the sea and hot mist often seeps from the cracks.

112.name: Sea Field Isle
112.desc: A rare stretch of fertile shoreland in the central chain, where fresh water and sea breezes nourish fields upon fields.

113.name: Undertow Poison Bay
113.desc: A poisonous marsh bay on the edge of the southwestern chain, where foul water, undertows, and humid miasma mingle.

114.name: Southern Reef Mountains
114.desc: A rolling belt of mountainous reefs among the southern islands; land routes are short and everywhere cut off by straits.

115.name: Bamboo Shadow Isles
115.desc: Small bamboo-covered isles scattered across the south-central sea, where bamboo shadows play on the water and the wind is often drowned by the tide.

116.name: Northern Mist Barren Isle
116.desc: Cold wasteland on a lone northern island, made eerily silent by sea mist and frozen earth.

117.name: Western Sea Gravel Isle
117.desc: A gravel isle beside the northwestern sand isle, its shores covered with weathered rock sand and salt crust.

201.name: Eastern Sea Gold Mansion
201.desc: A Metal-element cave dwelling deep in the Eastern Sea Rock Isle, where the sea wind turns into a clear sword hum once it enters.

202.name: Green Wood Bay Grotto-Heaven
202.desc: A Wood-element grotto-heaven in the Green Wood Inner Bay, where humid forest air and the vitality of the sea converge.

203.name: Northern Sea Mystic Water Realm
203.desc: A Water-element secret realm deep in the northern sea, encircled by hidden currents, with emerald light often glowing in its reef caves.

205.name: Cold Tide Mystic Palace
205.desc: An Earth-element mystic palace within the Cold Tide Snow Isle, where ice rock resonates with deep earth and the cave walls shine like jade.

301.name: Central Sea City
301.desc: A port city at the center of the isles, with shipyards, bridge markets, and floating docks spreading tier upon tier; the hub of all island traffic.

302.name: Sea Field City
302.desc: A farming and trading city on the edge of Sea Field Isle, where freshwater wells, salt warehouses, and grain markets stand side by side.

303.name: Sand Reef City
303.desc: A reef-shore city on the Northern Sea Sand Isle; caravans no longer travel sand roads but arrive by tide and sail.

304.name: Cold Bay City
304.desc: A sheltered city on the Northern Ice Isle, whose icy harbor and warm-stone streets protect the Water-element cultivators who pass through.

305.name: Lanyue Harbor
305.desc: A seaside moon harbor on a southeastern outer isle; at night the sea mirrors the moon, and seafaring cultivators moor here to watch the tide.

401.name: Jueyun Crag
401.desc: A cliffside sect on the Eastern Sea Rock Isle, its cloud bridges stretching along the sea cliffs above churning waves.

405.name: Thousand Mechanisms Reef Valley
405.desc: A valley of mechanisms on the Central Sea Lone Isle, where reef caves, stone bridges, and hidden doors have turned the whole island into a maze.

410.name: Southern Reef Echo Valley
410.desc: An echo valley in the Southern Reef Mountains, where sea wind passing through holes in the rock draws out long, zither-like notes.

411.name: Eastern Sea Maze Heaven
411.desc: A folded mountain gate on the Eastern Sea Rock Isle; sea mist drifts in and out, often leading people to mistake mountain paths for sea routes.

413.name: Eastern Forest Sage Isle
413.desc: An academy of stele forests on an eastern wooded island, its lecture halls built by the sea where the sound of the tide answers the chanting of texts.
